cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Not Why We Drifted
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation away from the real reason the relationship changed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I brought our picnic basket. Let's see if you remember how I taught you to lay out a proper lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I remember our last picnic. You said you needed space. Why?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: First correction: don't put the sandwiches in the sun. There's space under that tree; take the blanket over.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Moving won't stop me asking why.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll stay. Taste the mustard. You used to say everything was 'nice'; give me a proper criticism this time.

reason: Replace the removable teaching prefaces with pupil corrections that directly change how A pursues the exact Drive. Preserve the specific partner contribution and make the ending answer it.
